answer.reason: The verses only list Shemaiah among priests and among those in the dedication procession, and several of the marked verses may concern other men of the name, so no deed of this priest is stated.
doubts: NEH 12:34, 12:36 and 12:42 may refer to other men named Shemaiah, and NEH 12:36 and 12:42 do not say which Shemaiah is meant.
